source_excerpt: For every type alpha, assume alpha is nonempty and finite and assume a condition called Noetherian. Then those assumptions hold and, for every natural x, there is a natural y with x strictly less than y and x less than or equal to y.
normalized_statement: For every type alpha, assuming Nonempty alpha, Finite alpha, and Noetherian, the conclusion preserves those assumptions and for every natural x there exists a natural y such that x < y and x <= y; these assumptions have a concrete joint witness.
lean_statement: theorem bounded_witness (alpha : Type) (hNonempty : Nonempty alpha) (hFinite : Finite alpha) (Noetherian : Prop) (hNoetherian : Noetherian) : Nonempty alpha /\ Finite alpha /\ Noetherian /\ forall x : Nat, exists y : Nat, x < y /\ x <= y
reverse_rendering: For every type alpha, assuming Nonempty alpha, Finite alpha, and Noetherian, the result retains those facts and says that every natural x has a larger natural y.

obligations.description: The universal x binder precedes the existential y binder.
